# electrobridge

electrobridge is an aggregator for semiconductor and VLSI career opportunities, fellowships, and research positions.

## Core Features
- Aggregation of semiconductor and VLSI career opportunities without requiring login.
- Real-time updates on JRF, SRF, RA, and PhD positions from top Indian institutions (IITs, IISc, NITs, DRDO, ISRO, CSIR).
- International fellowships (DAAD, SINGA, MEXT) and PhD opportunities for electronics researchers.
- Private sector roles (VLSI Design, Physical Design, Verification, DFT, Embedded Systems).

## Main Sections
- [Opportunities](https://electrobridge.vercel.app/opportunities): Browse all active opportunities.
- [Organizations](https://electrobridge.vercel.app/organizations): Directory of universities, labs, and semiconductor companies.
- [News](https://electrobridge.vercel.app/news): Latest updates in the semiconductor industry.

## Target Audience
Electronics Engineers, VLSI Researchers, Embedded Systems Professionals, and students seeking research roles globally.
